items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

ctx.x: Well I’d probably have Bobby Hackett or Jack Teagarden and Eddie Condon and Jess Stacy, George Wettling, Walter Page on bass maybe, and I’d have Pee Wee Russell and Joe Marsala as my alternate clarinet players whenever I couldn’t make it.
That would be something to send them in as subs for you.
